# fleet_tmp_reaper must-fire fixture — the aged bulk the shell reaper could not see.
#
# Measured on the fleet host blitz-vps, 2026-08-13, root filesystem /dev/sda1
# (225G total, 165G used, 77% full; /tmp alone 63G).
#
#   set:    every top-level /tmp directory whose tree had no write in the
#           previous 12h, minus claude-<uid> session scratch, systemd-private-*,
#           snap-private-tmp and dotdirs
#   count:  299 directories
#   size:   49,989,951,488 bytes = 46.6 GiB, from
#           `sudo du -sB1 --one-file-system` over exactly this set — not a
#           blanket du of /tmp (du is not reclaim)
#
# 19 members are protected names, so the sweep must KEEP them and select the
# other 280. The reclaim figure is therefore 280 dirs, not the full 46.6 GiB.
#
# Two of the 19 are OS-owned (tmux-1000, org.chromium.Chromium.VJc8dO — 8 KiB
# combined). The other 17 are the disk-watchdog exclusions that the first cut of
# this module dropped and that were restored after the 2026-08-13 incident:
#
#   hermes-results          the LIVE Hermes tool-result store (~1,101 files that
#                           agents read back BY PATH). Its tree age says nothing
#                           about whether it is in use; deleting it breaks
#                           in-flight agents. This entry is the single most
#                           important KEEP in the fixture.
#   hermes_sandbox_*  (6)   live sandbox roots
#   tmp.*             (8)   mktemp -d default prefix
#   tsx-0, corepack-bin     toolchain caches
#
# Their presence here is the point: an age-only gate selected all 17.
#
# Of the 299, only 20 match the legacy prefix allowlist that gated candidacy at
# godmode-bus/bin/tmp-reaper.sh line 105:
#
#   ^(cfr-|omnia|permit-|roof-|a6-|auto-|lead-gen|kimi-|sol-|hermes-w|review|
#     security-|deep-|f530|rev5|califirst|cursor-|tmp\.)
#
# The remaining 279 (93.3%) were structurally invisible to it. That is the whole
# defect: the reaper logged "reaped=0 ... skipped=13" every ten minutes while
# 46.6 GiB of reclaimable space sat on a 77%-full root.
#
# MUST FIRE: tests/scripts/test_fleet_tmp_reaper.py rebuilds every name below as
# an aged directory and asserts the sweep selects all 280 non-protected ones.
# Reintroducing any name or prefix allowlist into the candidate gate collapses
# that to ~20 and fails the test loudly.
#
# Largest measured members, for scale:
#   6.2GiB cursor-sandbox-cache          1.4GiB p63-omnia
#   5.3GiB hermes-mp13-work              1.4GiB wt-pr901
#   1.9GiB hermes-symptomd-slice2-...    1.4GiB t138-p51-engine
#   1.6GiB t138-p51-site                 1.4GiB rev-900-head
#   1.4GiB tmp.w53s1                     1.3GiB security-pnpm-store
#   1.4GiB t7e1-860-run15875             1.3GiB ha-a-t_76861ceb
